canonical_claim.template: In 2025, FHA applications under $150,000 in New Hampshire were denied 63.3% of the time against 19.6% for loans over $250,000, a small-loan penalty of {value}.

required_qualifiers.population: decisioned FHA applications in New Hampshire

does_not_establish: that loan size causes denial (applicant and property mix differ by loan size)
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
